z-m-19-02.title: Pane chirevo chimwe chete here chine quadratic chine mhinduro mbiri dziri 2 ne −5?
z-m-19-02.topic: Kugadzira chirevo chequadratic kubva pamhinduro mbiri dzakapiwa, nemamiriro okuchigadzirisa kuva chimwe
z-m-19-02.goal: Ratidza nemienzaniso yakati wandei kuti kunyange kana mhinduro mbiri dzakapiwa, chirevo chequadratic hachigadziriswi kuva chimwe, uye urongedze kuti ruzivo rwuri rwupi rwunogadzirisa chirevo kuva chimwe uye rwupi rusiri ruzivo rutsva.
z-m-19-02.material: Sua akabvunza quiz. "Ndiudze chirevo chequadratic chine mhinduro (midzi) mbiri x=2 ne x=−5." Chirevo chequadratic chinonyorwa ax²+bx+c=0 (a≠0), uye pazasi, a, b, c dzinhamba dzakazara. (Verenga x² se "x squared" uye −5 se "minus 5".)
z-m-19-02.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei inosangana nemamiriro uye kutsvaga hukama pakati payo
z-m-19-02.thinking.2: Kurongedza kana mamiriro akawedzerwa ari ruzivo rutsva chaizvo
z-m-19-02.prereq.0: Zvinoreva mhinduro dzechirevo chequadratic, nokutarisa nokutsiva mhinduro
z-m-19-02.s.s1.prompt: Chirevo chequadratic chinogadzirisirwa kuva chimwe neruzivo rwokuti 'mhinduro ndi 2 ne −5' oga here?
z-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wagadzira chirevo chimwe chequadratic chine mhinduro 2 ne −5 (semuenzaniso wedzera (x−2)(x+5)=0), uye uise mhinduro kuti utarise kuti inova 0.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.1: Edza kana ungagadzira chirevo chine mhinduro dzakafanana asi makoefficient akasiyana nechawakagadzira, uye uise mhinduro kuti utarise.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.a: Chagadzirwa. Kana mhinduro dzakafanana, chirevo chinogona kungova chakafanana
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.a: Hauna kuedza kana pangava nezvirevo zvakawanda zvine mhinduro dzakafanana. Mushure mokugadzira chirevo chimwe chine mhinduro 2 ne −5, edza kuchinja makoefficient.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.b: Hazvisarudzwi. Asi zvirevo zvakafanana mhinduro ndezviviri chete zvine chiratidzo che a chakachinjwa
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.b: Zvakarurama kuti chirevo hachisarudzwi kuva chimwe, asi hachisi chiratidzo chete chinochinja. Gadzirawo zvirevo umo hukuru hwe a hwakachinjwa kuva 2 kana 3, uye uise mhinduro.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.c: Hazvisarudzwi. Pangava nezvimwe zvirevo zvine mhinduro dzakafanana
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.d: Zvasarudzwa. Chirevo chinobva pakuwedzera (x−2)(x+5)=0, chakagadzirwa kubva pamhinduro mbiri, ndiyo mhinduro
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.d: Unogona kugadzira chirevo chimwe nokuwedzera (x−2)(x+5)=0, asi chirevo chakagadzirwa nokuchiwanza nenhamba isiri zero chinewo mhinduro dzakafanana. Tsiva mhinduro muchirevo chine makoefficient akasiyana.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.explain: Kana ukaisa x=2 ne x=−5 mu x²+3x−10=0, zvose zvinopa 0, uye 2x²+6x−20=0, inowanza mativi ose echirevo ichi na 2, inochengetawo mhinduro dzose mbiri. Saka mhinduro dzoga hadzisarudzi chirevo kuva chimwe. Muchinhanho chinotevera, tichagadzira zvirevo isu pachedu kuti tione kuti zvingani zvinogoneka.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira zvirevo zvequadratic 3 zvakasiyana ax²+bx+c=0 zvine x=2 ne x=−5 zvose semhinduro. (a, b, c dzinhamba dzakazara uye −9≤a≤9)
z-m-19-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tora kuwedzera kwechirevo (x−2)(x+5)=0 chakagadzirwa kubva pamhinduro sepokutangira, uye uedze shanduko dzipi dzinosiya mhinduro sezvadzakaita.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora makoefficient (a, b, c) ezvirevo zvawakagadzira patafura uye uenzanise kuti b ne c zvinochinja sei pamwe chete na a kana a ichichinja.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Chirevo chequadratic uye makoefficient anosangana nemamiriro.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a haifaniri kuva 0 uye inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara kubva pa −9 kusvika pa 9, uye b ne c dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzakazara zvakare.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Isa x=2. Rutivi rwokuruboshwe runova 0 here?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Isa x=−5. Rutivi rwokuruboshwe runova 0 here?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.explain: Kutsiva x=2 ne x=−5 kunopa 4a+2b+c=0 ne 25a−5b+c=0, uye kubva pazvirevo zviviri izvi unowana b=3a, c=−10a. Saka kana wasarudza a, b ne c zvinotevera, uye zvirevo zvinogoneka ndezve x²+3x−10=0 nemativi ose akawanzwa nenhamba imwe chete isiri zero.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Hukama hupi huri pakati pezvirevo zvawakagadzira? Nyora kuti makoefficient akachinja sei, uchiisa nhamba.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isa a, b, c dzezvirevo zviviri zvawakagadzira padivi pomumwe uye uzvienzanise nokuparadzanisa (reshiyo).
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Isa x=2 muchirevo chakagadzirwa nokuwanza mativi ose e x²+3x−10=0 nenhamba imwe chete.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here kuti hukama hwakafanana hunoshanda muzvirevo zvose zvawakagadzira?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here, kunyange mumutsetse mumwe, kuti sei hukama uhwu husingachinji mhinduro?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana ukawanza mativi ose e x²+3x−10=0 na 2, inova 2x²+6x−20=0. Makoefficient ose akakura nechikamu chimwe chete uye mhinduro dzakafanana.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Muzvirevo zvandakagadzira, kana a yaiva 1, 2, −1, b yaiva 3a uye c yaiva −10a. Ndakawanza chirevo chose nenhamba imwe chete, saka mhinduro mbiri hadzichinji.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Pandakachinja a kuva 1, 2, −1, b yakatevera se 3a uye c se −10a. Reshiyo yemakoefficient inogara yakafanana, 1:3:−10.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.prompt: Sua anoda kuwedzera mamiriro ekugadzirisa chirevo kuva chimwe. Pamusoro pemamiriro okuti mhinduro ndi 2 ne −5, sarudza mamiriro ose anogadzirisa chirevo chequadratic ax²+bx+c=0 (a, b, c nhamba dzakazara) kuva chimwe.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.hint.0: Uchishandisa hukama b=3a, c=−10a, shandura mamiriro ega ega kuva chirevo chinoshandisa a chete.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga kana a inosangana nemamiriro akashandurwa iri imwe chete kana dzakawanda.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.o.a: Koefficient a ye x² iri pamusoro pe 0
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.a: a=1, 2, 3 ... dzose dzinosara, saka hazvigadziriswi kuva chimwe. Kusarudza chiratidzo chete hakusarudzi hukuru hwenhamba inowanzwa.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.b: Kana ukashaya hukama c=−10a, zvakaoma kuziva kuti mamiriro aya anosarudza a.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.c: Kana mhinduro mbiri dziri 2 ne −5, huwandu hwatova −3. Wakatora kudzokorora ruzivo rwatopiwa seruzivo rutsva.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.d: Kana ukatsiva hukama pakati pe a, b, c uye ukanyora a+b+c netsamba imwe, unogona kuona kuti mamiriro aya anosarudza a.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.o.e: a, b, c dzose hadzisi zero
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.e: Kana a isiri 0, ipapo b=3a ne c=−10a hadzisi 0 zvakare, saka izvi zvatoshanda. Hauna ruzivo rutsva.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.f: Kana a=1, ipapo b=3 ne c=−10 zvasarudzwa. Zvinoratidza chimiro umo kana koefficient imwe yasarudzwa, mamwe anotevera.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.explain: Kana mhinduro ndi2 ne−5, saka (a, b, c)=(a, 3a, −10a). Kana c=−10a=−10, saka a=1; kana a=1, saka (1, 3, −10); kana a+b+c=a+3a−10a=−6a=−6, saka a=1; zvose zvinoitara seimwe chete. Mamiriro ekuti a ipositive anosiya a se1, 2, 3 ..., uye zvirevo zvekuti sum yemhinduro mbiri ndi−3 uye kuti ma coefficients ose haasi zero zvaiva ruzivo rwatozikanwa, saka haagoni kudzikisa equation.

z-m-19-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b ndema natural number anosangana nemamiriro.
z-m-19-01.title: √a+√b inoenzana ne √(a+b) here?
z-m-19-01.topic: Huwandu hwenhamba mbiri dzine square roots hunogona kunyorwa muchimiro chipi?
z-m-19-01.goal: Ratidza nomuenzaniso mumwe wakapesana kuti '√a+√b=√(a+b)' hazvishande nguva dzose, tsvaga iwe pachako mapeya (a, b) umo huwandu hwemasquare roots maviri unopfupiswa kuva chimiro chimwe che radical, uye unyore chinhu chavo chinofanana nemashoko.
z-m-19-01.material: Minjae akati, "Kunyora huwandu hwemasquare roots maviri, wedzera nhamba dziri pasi pemasaini e radical uye uinyore seimwe. Semuenzaniso, √2+√3 i √5." Pazasi, ngatiti a ne b dzose dziri pamusoro pe 0, uye chirevo chaMinjae ngachive '√a+√b=√(a+b)' (root a plus root b inoenzana ne root yehuwandu hwose a plus b). Rereferenzi: √2≈1.414, √3≈1.732, √5≈2.236.
z-m-19-01.thinking.0: Kuedza chirevo nenhamba chaidzo uye kunzwisisa simba romuenzaniso mumwe unopesana
z-m-19-01.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei inosangana nemamiriro uye kutsvaga chimiro chinofanana
z-m-19-01.prereq.1: Kutsvaga kukosha kunenge kwemasquare roots nekarikuretara
z-m-19-01.s.s1.prompt: Kuedza chirevo chaMinjae, takaisa a=9, b=16. √9=3 ne √16=4, saka √9+√16=7, uye √(9+16)=√25=5. Nzira yakakodzera zvikuru yokududzira mhedzisiro iyi ndeipi?
z-m-19-01.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga √9+√16 ne √(9+16) zvakasiyana, uzvinyore padivi pomumwe, uye uzvienzanise.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti mienzaniso ingani isingashandi inofanira kuvapo kuti 'inoshanda kuna a, b dzose' ive yenhema.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.a: Muenzaniso uyu chete ndouwakanganisa, uye unogona kushanda kuna a, b dzimwe
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.a: Chirevo che 'kuna a, b dziri pamusoro pe 0 dzose' chinoputswa nomuenzaniso mumwe chete usingashande. Kutora mumwe semuenzaniso unosiyana kunoreva kuchinja chirevo kuva 'chinowanzo kururama.'
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.b: Unofanira kutsvaga mimwe mienzaniso mishoma woramba uchikanganisa usati wataura kuti chirevo chakanganisa
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.b: Kuratidza kuti chirevo chakarurama, mienzaniso yakawanda yakadini haikwani, asi kuratidza kuti chakanganisa, muenzaniso mumwe wakapesana unokwana. Uri kubata mamiriro maviri ose nenzira imwe chete.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.c: 7 ne 5 zvakasiyana, saka chirevo ichi hachishande kuna a, b dziri pamusoro pe 0 dzose
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.d: 9 ne 16 masikweya akakwana saka akasiyana, saka kuedza uku hakugoni kushandiswa sehumbowo
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.d: Chirevo chinoti 'a, b dziri pamusoro pe 0,' saka masikweya akakwana anosanganisirwa. Kurasa kuedza nokuti kukosha kuri kuoneka kwakasiyana kunokubvumira kudzivisa muenzaniso unopesana.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.explain: Kana chirevo chiri che 'nguva dzose,' muenzaniso mumwe usingashande (√9+√16=7, √25=5) unokwana kuuputsa. Asi, izvi zvinoreva chete kuti 'chirevo ichi hachisi chechokwadi nguva dzose,' kwete kuti hapana huwandu hunogona kunyorwa semusaini mumwe we radical. Muchinhanho chinotevera tinotsvaga mamiriro akadaro.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.prompt: Nzira yaMinjae yakanganisa, asi pane mamiriro umo √a+√b inopfupiswa kuva chimiro chimwe p√m (p, m nhamba dzechisikigo). Tsvaga mapeya 3 akasiyana (a, b) akadaro. Mamiriro: a ne b nhamba dzechisikigo ne 2≤a<b≤200, uye ari a kana b haisi sikweya rakakwana (1, 4, 9, 16 ...).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza peya ipi zvayo, senge a=5, b=7, tsvaga huwandu nekarikuretara, uye utarise kana kukosha uku kwakaparadzaniswa ne √5 kuri nhamba yechisikigo.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora mapeya mashoma akabudirira padivi pomumwe uye utarise hukama pakati pe a ne b (kukosha kwokuwedzera, kuwanza, kana kuparadzanisa).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Ari a kana b haisi sikweya rakakwana.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.fail.c2: a kana b isikweya rakakwana. Richinje kuva nhamba isiri sikweya rakakwana.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Kupeya iri, huwandu hahupfupisiki kuva chimiro chimwe che radical. Nyora √a ne √b rimwe nerimwe muchimiro chaso chakapfupiswa zvikuru padivi pomumwe uye uzvienzanise.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, √2+√8=√2+2√2=3√2, √3+√12=√3+2√3=3√3, √12+√27=2√3+3√3=5√3. Chete kana nhamba imwe chete yakasara pasi pe radical kana yapfupiswa zvakanyanya ndipo pavanogona kubatanidzwa kuva imwe. Kumapeya akadaro, a×b isikweya rakakwana (2×8=16, 3×12=36, 12×27=324). Zvinopesana, kana nhamba dzakasara dzakasiyana, se √5+√7, hadzigoni kubatanidzwa kuva radical imwe.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Unoona chii chinofanana mumapeya awakawana? Uye nyora, uchiisa nhamba, kuti sei mutsetse waMinjae √a+√b=√(a+b) usingashande pane rimwe remapeya awakawana.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Pane rimwe remapeya awakawana, nyora a ne b rimwe nerimwe se (nhamba yechisikigo)×√(nhamba diki).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tsvaga kukosha kunenge kwe √a+√b ne √(a+b) nekarikuretara uye uzvienzanise.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here kuti chinhu chinofanana chawakataura chinoshanda chaizvo kumapeya ose awakawana?
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakaratidza here kuti mutsetse waMinjae wakanganisa nokuenzanisa kukosha kuviri (huwandu ne √(a+b))?
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Kuna (2, 8), √8=2√2, saka √2+2√2=3√2. Ipeya umo nhamba dziri pasi pe radical dzakafanana kana dzapfupiswa. Asi √(2+8)=√10≈3.16 uye 3√2≈4.24, saka kukosha kwakasiyana, uye mutsetse waMinjae hausi chokwadi.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Kutarisa (3, 12) ne (12, 27), chigadzirwa che a ne b chisikweya rakakwana, sepa 3×12=36 ne 12×27=324. Semuenzaniso, √3+√12=3√3≈5.20, asi √15≈3.87, saka hazvienzani.

z-m-19-03.title: Chii chinoitika kuminimum kana renji re x rachinja?
z-m-19-03.topic: Maximum neminimum ye quadratic function ine renji re x rakadzorwa
z-m-19-03.goal: Kana renji idzva re x rapiwa, chengeta kana kuchinja kutonga kwako nezve minimum ye quadratic function, uye ugadzire iwe pachako renji umo vertex iri kunze kwerenji uye utsvage minimum yayo.
z-m-19-03.material: Doha akanyora zvakare quadratic function y=x²−4x+1 se y=(x−2)²−3 uye akati, "Minimum ndi−3." Asi zvichienderana nenyaya, renji remakosha anogona kutorwa ne x rinochinjawo. Padanho rimwe nerimwe, renji (senge x ndi3 kana kupfuura uye 6 kana pasi) netafura yemakosha e y anowanikwa nekuisa makosha mashoma e x zvinoratidzwa zvitsva. Funga ma real numbers x ose mukati merenji.
z-m-19-03.thinking.0: Kuchengeta kana kuchinja kutonga zvichienderana neruzivo rutsva
z-m-19-03.thinking.1: Kuparadzanisa kuita nyaya zvichienderana nekuti vertex iri mukati kana kunze kwerenji
z-m-19-03.thinking.2: Kugadzira iwe pachako renji rinokodzera mamiriro uye kutarisa kukosha
z-m-19-03.prereq.0: Kuverenga vertex ne axis of symmetry ye quadratic function y=a(x−p)²+q (nhanho yegrade 9)
z-m-19-03.prereq.1: Kuisa kukosha kwe x mu expression kuwana kukosha kwe y
z-m-19-03.s.s1.prompt: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, tonga kuti chii chinoitika kuchirevo chaDoha 'minimum ndi−3' zvichienderana nerenji re x.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kuti kukosha kudiki kwe y mutafura kunoitika pa x ipi uye kana x iyoyo iri mukati merenji iri.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.hint.1: Isa x isiri mutafura (semuenzaniso, 2.5 kana 3.5) mu expression uye uedze kana inova diki kupfuura makosha ari mutafura.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Renji: x ndi ma real numbers ose. Expression: y=(x−2)²−3. Tafura yemakosha (x → y): 0 → 1, 1 → −2, 2 → −3, 3 → −2, 4 → 1.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.after: (x−2)²≥0, saka y≥−3, uye kana x=2, y=−3. Mutafura zvakare, kukosha kudiki ndi−3 pa x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakasarudza kukosha kwepagumo retafura. Enzanisa kuti kukosha kudiki kwe y mutafura yose kuri kupi.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakamira padhuze ne x=1 kana x=3. Enzanisa nekukosha pa x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kunyange x iri real number ipi neipi, (x−2)² haidzikiri pasi pe0. Tarisa kana kukosha kuchidzikira kusingaperi.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Mamiriro matsva: renji re x rakachinja kuita 0≤x≤5. Tafura yemakosha (x → y): 0 → 1, 1 → −2, 2 → −3, 3 → −2, 4 → 1, 5 → 6.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Renji rakava dzvinyiriro. Uchatonga sei nezve minimum?
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.after: x=2 iri mukati merenji, saka −3 inogona kubuda zvakare, uye nekuda kwechimiro che expression, (x−2)²≥0, haidzikiri pasi pe−3 kunyange pa x isiri mutafura. Kunyange neruzivo rutsva, kutonga kunogona kuramba kwakadaro. Kutaura kubva patafura oga kuti 'zvakaoma kuva nechokwadi' kwaiva kungwarira kunonzwisisikawo.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Inoramba iri −3. x=2 iri mukati merenji iri
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Inochinja. Minimum ndi y=1 pagumo rekuruboshwe rerenji, x=0
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakafunga kuti kana renji rachinja, gumo rinova minimum. Tarisa mutafura kana kukosha pa x=2 kuri mukati merenji.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zvakaoma kuva nechokwadi kubva patafura oga. Inogona kuva diki kupfuura −3 pa x isiri mutafura
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Inochinja. Minimum ndi y=6 pagumo rekurudyi rerenji, x=5
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wakasarudza kukosha pagumo rekurudyi. Enzanisa nekukosha kudiki mutafura.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Mamiriro matsva: renji re x rakachinja kuita 3≤x≤6 (x=2 ye vertex haisi mukati merenji iri). Tafura yemakosha (x → y): 3 → −2, 4 → 1, 5 → 6, 6 → 13.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.after: x=2 iri kunze kwerenji, saka −3 haigoni kubuda. Mukati merenji, y inokura sezvo x ichikura, saka minimum −2 inobuda pa x=3 iri kuruboshwe zvikuru.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ndiko kukosha pa x=2. Tarisa kana x iyoyo iri mukati merenji iri.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ndiko kukosha kwepakati kwetafura. Enzanisa zvakare kuti kukosha kudiki kwe y mutafura kuri kupi.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakasarudza kukosha kukuru mutafura. Tarisazve kuti minimum ndeipi.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.reflect: Kutonga kwekutanga, 'kukosha kwe y kwe vertex ndiyo minimum,' kwakarurama chete kana x ye vertex iri mukati merenji. Sezvakaitwa padanho 2, kutonga kunogona kuramba kwakadaro kunyange neruzivo rutsva, uye sezvakaitwa padanho 3, unofanira kuchinja kutonga kana mamiriro achichinja. Chinokosha kutarisa kuti chii chakachinja (kana vertex iri mukati kana kunze kwerenji) uye usarudze kuchengeta kana kuchinja.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.prompt: Kune y=x²−4x+1, seta renji re x se p≤x≤q (p, q ma integers, −4≤p<q≤8) kuti x=2 ye vertex ive kunze kwerenji. Nyorawo minimum m murenji iroro. Gadzira marenji 2 akasiyana.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ratidza pa number line kuti p ne q dzinofanira kuva padivi ripi re2 kuti renji risasanganisire x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga makosha e y pa x mbiri dzemagumo erenji rawakasarudza uye utarise kana yakaderera yakaenzana ne m.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c1: p ne q dzinofanira kuva ma integers ane −4≤p<q≤8.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.ok.c2: x=2 ye vertex iri kunze kwerenji.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c2: x=2 iri pakati pe p ne q. Chinja renji kuti risasanganisire 2.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c3: m haina kururama. Tsvaga makosha e y pa x mbiri dzemagumo erenji uye uaenzanise.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.explain: Kana x=2 ye vertex iri kunze kwerenji, y inochinja nenzira imwe chete mukati merenji. Saka minimum inobuda pagumo rakaswedera padhuze ne2. semuenzaniso, kune 3≤x≤6, ndi−2 pa x=3; kune −3≤x≤0, ndi1 pa x=0; kune −4≤x≤1, ndi−2 pa x=1. Hapana nyaya umo −3 inobuda.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.prompt: Kune imwe function, y=−(x−1)²+4, unoda kutsvaga maximum kana renji re x riri −2≤x≤0. Chii chakakodzera kutanga kutarisa?
z-m-19-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ratidza −2, 0, ne x=1 ye vertex pa number line.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti nzvimbo apo maximum inoitika inosiyana sei zvichienderana nekuti x ye vertex iri mukati merenji.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.a: Nyora pakarepo 4, kukosha kwe y kwe vertex (1, 4), semaximum
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.a: Hauna kutarisa kana x ye vertex iri mukati merenji. Idambudziko rimwe chete nechikonzero chekuti −3 yakanga isingagoni kubuda mudanho rekare.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.b: Tsvaga makosha e y pamagumo ose erenji, x=−2 ne x=0, uye usarudze hombe
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.b: Kune function nerenji iri mhinduro imwe chete inobuda, asi inzira inogona kusiya kukosha kwe vertex kana vertex iri mukati merenji.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.c: Graph inokombama kumusoro, saka tanga watsvaga minimum
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.c: Chinobvunzwa ndiyo maximum, saka pamwe wakasanganisa hukama pakati penzira yekukombama nemaximum neminimum.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.d: Tanga watarisa kana x-coordinate 1 ye vertex iri mukati merenji −2≤x≤0
z-m-19-03.s.s3.explain: x=1 haisi mukati me −2≤x≤0, saka maximum haisi 4 ye vertex. Mukati merenji, y inokura sezvo x ichikura, saka maximum ndi y=3 pa x=0, uye pa x=−2 ndi−5. Kana vertex iri mukati merenji, kukosha kwe vertex musarudzwa; kana iri kunze, makosha emagumo ndivo vasarudzwa.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.acc.0: Kune function nerenji iri, x=1 ye vertex iri kunze kwerenji, saka nzira yekuenzanisa magumo ose maviri inopawo mhinduro imwe chete, 3. Zvisinei, mune dzimwe nyaya apo vertex iri mukati merenji, unogona kusiya kukosha kwe vertex, saka tsika yekutanga kutarisa nzvimbo ye vertex yakachengeteka zvakanyanya.

z-m-19-04.title: Inscribed angles pa arcs dzakareba zvakafanana dzakaenzana here?
z-m-19-04.topic: Inscribed angles nekureba kwe arc: inscribed angles pa arcs dzakareba zvakafanana
z-m-19-04.goal: Tsvaga mutsara unotadza mutsananguro 'kana kureba kwema arcs kwakaenzana, inscribed angles dzakaenzana,' tsvaga inscribed angles dzakaumbwa nema arcs akareba zvakafanana mumadenderedzwa ane ma radii akasiyana, uye woisa mamiriro apo chirevo chinoshanda.
z-m-19-04.material: Denderedzwa O rine radius 6 cm, uye denderedzwa O' (O prime) rine radius 12 cm. Arc AB padenderedzwa O ne arc CD padenderedzwa O' dzose dzine kureba kwe4π cm, uye arc imwe neimwe idiki kupfuura semicircle. Doyun akati, "Inscribed angles pa arcs dzakareba zvakafanana dzakaenzana," uye akatsanangura sezvizvi pazasi. (Inscribed angle ∠APB ndiyo kona apo poinzi P padenderedzwa, padivi rakasiyana ne arc AB, inotarisa A ne B, uye ∠CQD zvakafananawo. ∠APB inoverengwa 'angle APB'.)
z-m-19-04.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso yenhamba yakawanda kuona chimiro chemuenzaniso unopikisa
z-m-19-04.prereq.0: Saizi ye inscribed angle pa arc ihafu yesaizi yekona yepakati pa arc iyoyo (nhanho yegrade 9)
z-m-19-04.prereq.1: Kureba kwe arc 2πr×(x/360) kune kona yepakati x° mudenderedzwa re radius r (nhanho yegrade 7)
z-m-19-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe mutsananguro yaDoyun usingagoni kuvimbwa. (Zvakanakisa kusarudza mutsara wekutanga unotadza, asi unogonawo kusarudza mutsara umo mhedziso yakashata yakanyorwa nekuda kwazvo.)
z-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kana mutsara mumwe nemumwe unotevera zvakananga kubva kumutsara wapfuura, uye ucherechedze kana ma radii emadenderedzwa maviri akafanana kana akasiyana.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga zvakaparadzana kuti kona yepakati ye arc ine kureba kwe4π ndi degrees mangani mudenderedzwa rimwe nerimwe uye uvaenzanise.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.0: Denderedzwa O rine radius 6, denderedzwa O' rine radius 12, uye ma arcs AB ne CD dzose dzine kureba kwe4π.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.1: Kureba kwema arcs kwakaenzana, saka saizi dzemakona epakati e ma arcs maviri dzakaenzanawo.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.2: Inscribed angle ihafu yekona yepakati, saka ∠APB ne ∠CQD dzakaenzanawo.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.3: Saka inscribed angles pa arcs dzakareba zvakafanana dzinogara dzakaenzana.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.explain: Mutsara wekutanga unotadza ndi mutsara 2. Kureba kwe arc kunotarwa neradius nekona yepakati pamwe chete, saka mumadenderedzwa maviri ane ma radii akasiyana, kunyange kureba kwakaenzana, makona epakati anosiyana. Mudenderedzwa O, 4π=2π×6×(x/360) inopa kona yepakati ye120°, uye mudenderedzwa O', 4π=2π×12×(x/360) inopa kona yepakati ye60°. Saka inscribed angles dzinosiyana, 60° ne30°. 'Inscribed angle ihafu yekona yepakati' mumutsara 3 chirevo chakarurama, asi chinotakura mhedzisiro yemutsara 2, saka mhedziso yakashata, uye mutsara 4 zvakafanana. Mutsara 1 mamiriro akapiwa, saka hauna dambudziko.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.prompt: Padenderedzwa re radius r cm pane arc ine kureba kwe4π cm (semicircle kana diki). Tsvaga inscribed angle θ (degrees) pa arc iyi, uye ugadzire madenderedzwa 3 ane ma radii akasiyana. (r inobva ku4 kusvika ku30, uye nyora r ne θ semakosha chaiwo.)
z-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga watsvaga kona yepakati ye arc ine kureba kwe4π mudenderedzwa rine r=6, uye utsvage inscribed angle kubva pairi.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora r ne θ mutafura uye utsvage kuti product kana sum yemakosha maviri iri yakagara.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c1: r inofanira kubva ku4 kusvika ku30.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Iyi ndiyo inscribed angle inokodzera kureba kwe arc 4π.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Kona yepakati ndi2θ. Tarisa kana kureba kwe arc 2πr×(2θ/360) kuri 4π. Sarudza r inopa kukosha chaiko, kwete kukosha kwakafanofungidzirwa.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.explain: Kona yepakati ndi2θ, saka kureba kwe arc ndi 2πr×(2θ/360)=πrθ/90. Kana iri 4π, saka rθ=360. Kana r=6, θ=60; kana r=12, θ=30; kana r=9, θ=40; kana r=4, θ=90. Kunyange nekureba kwe arc kumwe chete, radius ichikura, inscribed angle inova diki.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangura kuna Doyun. Mamiriro api ekuwedzera anodiwa kuti utaure kuti inscribed angles pa arcs mbiri dzakareba zvakafanana dzakaenzana? Uye nei dzichiva dzakaenzana pasi pemamiriro iwayo?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.0: Tarisa kuti θ ndi chii kana r yakafanana mutafura ye s2.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti kureba kwe arc, radius, nekona yepakati, ndechipi chinofanira kuva chakafanana kuti inscribed angles dzienzane.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here kuti mamiriro awakanyora anobvisa mienzaniso yose yawakagadzira mu s2 (madenderedzwa ane ma radii akasiyana)?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here 'nei dzichiva dzakaenzana' maererano nekona yepakati?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.model.0: Ma arcs mbiri anofanira kuva padenderedzwa rimwe chete (kana madenderedzwa ane radius imwe chete). Kana radius yakafanana, saka kana kureba kwema arcs kwakaenzana makona epakati akaenzana, uye inscribed angle ihafu yekona yepakati, saka dzinova dzakaenzana.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.model.1: Mamiriro ekuti ma radii akafanana anodiwa. Kana akasiyana, senge 6 ne12, makona epakati anosiyana, 120° ne60°, saka inscribed angles ndi60° ne30°. Neradius imwe chete, kona yepakati iri proportional nekureba kwe arc, saka inscribed angles dzakaenzanawo.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kutaura 'makona epakati akaenzana' panzvimbo ye 'kureba kwema arcs' zvirimo zvakafanana.
